note: Shared routing registry. Only entries meant for coworkers live here. Machine-private entries belong in projects.local.json; entries that travel with a project root belong in that root's registryFile (see meta.config.json).

rules: Classify the request before searching sibling repos.
For helpdesk/ticket work, start in TicketTracker CLI, then route to one technical project.
Load only that project's AGENTS.md / README before broad search.
Broaden to relatedProjects only when evidence requires it.
An entry marked optional may be absent on this machine: follow its whenMissing advice instead of guessing at paths or commands.
Keep work and personal roots isolated: do not open a project in another root unless the user names that project or explicitly asks to move material between them.
related lists stay same-root only; cross-root handoffs are chat opt-in, not automatic routing.
Run .\meta.ps1 routing to see which entries resolved to a real folder.

projects.name: TicketTracker
projects.purpose: Local ticket assistant for iSupport and future helpdesk systems - sync, search, notes, recommendations.
projects.whenPresent: Identify the ticket with .\TicketTracker.ps1 search or brief <id>. Persist findings with post / recommend so they reach iSupport; note is local only.
projects.whenMissing: No local ticket tooling on this machine. Ask the user to paste the ticket text and id, record outcomes wherever they track work, and do not invent ticket numbers or claim anything was written back to iSupport.

projects.name: Solarwinds
projects.purpose: Orion platform-as-code - alerts, monitors, templates, dashboards, dependencies.
projects.whenPresent: Discover with .\module\public\Get-OrionCatalog.ps1 -Type <type> -Name '<pattern>'. Edit under src/ only; never open catalog/index.json or index.yaml wholesale.
projects.whenMissing: No Orion platform-as-code checkout here. Answer from the SolarWinds web console workflow instead, and do not reference src/ paths, catalog files, or module commands as if they exist locally.
